text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S had an excellent showing in 
her debut race. Finding no issues with her 
body, she executed her run exactly as 
planned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she gives an interview, 
stating that her purpose for coming to 
Japan is a "revolution"—to bring the 
Japanese racing world to a globally 
competitive level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her remarks were exaggerated in the next 
day's articles, causing some to push back 
against her uncalled-for interference. But 
she remained unfazed, thinking only of 
fulfilling her "mission."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Tanino Gimlet, recognizing her 
as a rival, issued a declaration of 
rivalry, saying she looked forward to 
facing her in a race someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S decided to enter races 
while continuing her training, racking up 
real combat experience. Her warrior's 
journey was now officially underway.
